export const RELEASE_NOTES: readonly ReleaseEntry[] = [
  {version:"5.70.0",date:"2026-07-21",title:"Final Integrity, E2E & Release Readiness",summary:"Builder, Sheet, Play Mode, Rest, Backup and offline PWA evidence are unified behind one honest release gate.",changes:[{text:"Final release evidence gate with blocker and warning separation",category:"Teknik"},{text:"Browser E2E preflight prevents retry storms when Chromium is missing",category:"Düzeltme"},{text:"Stable release version gate updated to 5.70.0",category:"Teknik"},{text:"One-command release verification workflow",category:"İyileştirme"}]},
  {version:"5.39.0",date:"2026-07-18",title:"Rogue Race, Subclass & Level Certification",summary:"2014/2024 Rogue; bütün mevcut race/species, Thief/Assassin ve level 1-20 kombinasyonlarında derin sertifikadan geçirildi.",changes:[{text:"760 Rogue race/species × subclass × level senaryosu",category:"Teknik"},{text:"2024 Weapon Mastery bütün levellerde 2 olarak düzeltildi",category:"Düzeltme"},{text:"Reliable Talent, Blindsense ve Slippery Mind edition-aware hale getirildi",category:"Düzeltme"},{text:"Cunning Strike, Improved Cunning Strike ve Devious Strikes progression eklendi",category:"Özellik"},{text:"Thief ve Assassin 2014/2024 checkpointleri sertifikalandı",category:"Teknik"}]},
  {version:"5.34.0",date:"2026-07-18",title:"Druid Race, Circle & Level Certification",summary:"2014/2024 Druid; bütün mevcut race/species, Land/Moon ve level 1-20 kombinasyonlarında derin sertifikadan geçirildi.",changes:[{text:"760 Druid race/species × circle × level senaryosu",category:"Teknik"},{text:"2024 prepared spell 4-22 resmi tablosuna bağlandı",category:"Düzeltme"},{text:"2014 Archdruid sınırsız Wild Shape ve 2024 Short Rest +1 recovery düzeltildi",category:"Düzeltme"},{text:"Wild Shape known forms, CR, fly/swim progression sertifikalandı",category:"Teknik"},{text:"Primal Order, Wild Companion, Wild Resurgence ve Elemental Fury checkpointleri eklendi",category:"Özellik"},{text:"Circle of the Land ve Moon edition checkpointleri doğrulandı",category:"Teknik"}]},
  {version:"5.33.0",date:"2026-07-18",title:"Cleric Race, Domain & Level Certification",summary:"2014/2024 Cleric; bütün mevcut race/species, domain ve level 1-20 kombinasyonlarında derin sertifikadan geçirildi.",changes:[{text:"3.320 Cleric race/species × domain × level senaryosu",category:"Teknik"},{text:"2024 Channel Divinity 2/3/4 ve Short Rest +1 recovery düzeltildi",category:"Düzeltme"},{text:"2024 Divine Spark 1d8-4d8 progression düzeltildi",category:"Düzeltme"},{text:"2014 Destroy Undead ve 2024 Sear Undead ayrıldı",category:"Düzeltme"},{text:"2024 prepared spell tablosu sabit resmi progression ile bağlandı",category:"Düzeltme"},{text:"Life Domain ve bütün mevcut domain checkpointleri sertifikalandı",category:"Teknik"}]},
  {version:"5.32.0",date:"2026-07-18",title:"Bard Race, Subclass & Level Certification",summary:"2014/2024 Bard; bütün race/species, Lore/Valor ve level 1-20 kombinasyonlarında derin sertifikadan geçirildi.",changes:[{text:"760 Bard race/species × subclass × level senaryosu",category:"Teknik"},{text:"2014 known spells ve 2024 prepared spells tabloları düzeltildi",category:"Düzeltme"},{text:"2024 Expertise 2/9 ve Countercharm reaction akışı düzeltildi",category:"Düzeltme"},{text:"2014 Magical Secrets, Song of Rest ve Superior Inspiration edition-aware hale getirildi",category:"Özellik"},{text:"2024 Bard weapon proficiency Simple Weapons olarak düzeltildi",category:"Düzeltme"}]},
  {version:"5.30.1",date:"2026-07-18",title:"Builder ASI / Feat Slot Conflict Hotfix",summary:"Prevents a feat from consuming an ASI slot while old ability increases remain allocated.",changes:[{text:"Block feat selection when the same level slot still contains ASI points",category:"Düzeltme"},{text:"Show a clear ASI/feat conflict message instead of delayed 2/0 validation",category:"Düzeltme"},{text:"Add one-click ASI allocation reset for restored invalid drafts",category:"Özellik"},{text:"Add regression coverage for level 5 Cleric ASI-to-feat switching",category:"Teknik"}]},
  {version:"5.30.0",date:"2026-07-18",title:"Origin, Ability & High-Level Character Builder Reconstruction Mega Pack",summary:"Character Builder now separates base ability generation, origin bonuses and high-level ASI progression while closing major 2014/2024 origin gaps.",changes:[{text:"True assignable Standard Array and 27-point Point Buy controls",category:"Düzeltme"},{text:"Separate base, origin and level ASI ability layers",category:"Özellik"},{text:"2024 background +2/+1 and +1/+1/+1 distributions",category:"Düzeltme"},{text:"2014 Half-Elf flexible ability choices and mandatory subrace validation",category:"Düzeltme"},{text:"High-level ASI/feat budget controls with final score breakdown",category:"Özellik"},{text:"Ability-builder regression certification tests",category:"Teknik"}]},

notices: string[];
}
